thread:
sahil: heads-up — after merging the TP+flash-attn fusion PR, we're seeing a ~20-30% regression on 8xA100 runs for long sequences (8k). profiler shows QKV all-gather and extra memcpy dominating. anyone else seeing this? :thinking:

maria: can you paste the profile / top hotspots?

sahil: pasted below (shortened):
```
Timeline summary (8 GPUs, batch=4, seq=8192):
- QKV AllGather (per-layer): 42.1%
- FlashAttn fused kernel: 18.4%
- MatMul / linear kernels: 24.6%
- AllReduce (grad/ints): 8.0%
- cudaMemcpy / host-sync: 7.0%
Total token-tps down ~25% vs baseline (no fusion).
```

jon: yikes. are we doing an all-gather for QKV on every layer, or scatter/gather?

sahil: current fused path uses per-layer QKV all-gather to keep a single fused kernel path. tradeoff was fewer kernel launches but more comm overhead. seems fine for short seqs, but for long seqs the all-gather + buffer copies blow up.

alex: can you also share KV-cache behavior? with long-context, cached KV should reduce work — are we re-materializing or duplicating cache per shard?

sahil: KV cache is per-shard, but the fusion path currently copies cached KV into a contiguous buffer before all-gather to match the fused kernel layout. that extra copy + all-gather per-layer is the culprit.

maria: two quick hypotheses: 1) padding/mod alignment causing lots of small fragment all-gathers (seq % tp_chunk != 0), 2) no NCCL grouping -> many small collectives not overlapped with compute.

jon: +1. flame graphs I ran show idle compute waiting on final layers because of tail of many small collects. small all-gather sizes kill bandwidth.

sahil: repro script: `./perf/run_tp.sh --gpus 8 --seq 8192 --batch 4 --model 30b --fused-atten true`

alex: suggested fixes (rapid):
- switch fused path to QKV scatter/gather pattern so we produce local Q/K/V layout expected by flash kernel without full all-gather per layer.
- coalesce per-layer all-gathers into a single multi-layer collective when possible (agg across N layers).
- enforce pad-to-chunk (pad seq to tp_chunk multiple) in batching heuristics and track padding cost in optimizer to avoid regressions for short sequences.
- add NCCLGroup around per-layer collectives and pre-post non-blocking comm to allow compute overlap.

maria: also flag: KV-cache invalidation on dynamic batching. when batch sizes vary we currently re-shard cache which triggers extra comm. we should maintain a per-request cache index (stash) and only reshuffle on model- or route-level changes.

jon: I prototyped scatter/gather for QKV and a simple NCCLGroup: local run (8xA100) went from -25% to +12% vs baseline (i.e., recovered and slightly faster). still seeing a small memcpy hotspot around cache reformat.

infra-bot: perf-job queued: r-job-000123 -> running smoke + long-seq perf matrix (8/16 GPUs) :gear:

sahil: action items:
- jon: finish scatter/gather patch + unit test for KV cache invariants (ETA: tomorrow).
- alex: add batching pad-to-chunk and NCCL group change to runtime (ETA: 2d).
- maria: add perf regression test for dynamic-batch KV-cache reshuffle (ETA: 3d).
- infra-bot: post perf matrix results here when done.

maria: small note — add a gauge in console for per-request extra-comm-ms so product can see when routes hit this path.

sahil: thanks all. if infra-job shows + on 16-GPU we can roll a canary patch. ping me on thread for blocking issues. :thumbsup:
